about_the_game:
Give your hero a cute pet, a new haircut, and a powerful sci-fi spacesuit with the Hero Character Generator 2 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of MZ generator parts for your male characters, this time offering up 51 parts to choose from. 7 AccA, 6 AccB, 1 Cloak, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 2 Facial Mark, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair parts are ready to add some much-needed helmets to your sci-fi games and some important fantasy accessories that every game has been lacking: pets! Give your gruff and buff fighter some new armor and an adorable cat-like critter that hangs off his shoulder to let players know that he’s not as mean as he looks. Or reward your hero with a blue alien doggo for completing a tough side quest, so while he runs around space stations with his purple helmet and matching spacesuit he also has a cute companion!

Give your military party member some dress whites and matching hat when he needs to meet with important officers, and let your healer wear an extravagant gilded robe to help distract from his eyepatch. Show that an NPC has a punk attitude with some two-tone hair, or give them glaring eyes to make it seem like they’re always in a bad mood. Pick up the Hero Character Generator 2 for MZ pack and give your heroes some gorgeous new outfits and recognizable accessories so your players can easily find the character they’re looking for!


Contents:

・Clothes ("fantasy" style) = 20
・Accessories
・Eyes = 5 sets
・Front Hair = 5
・Rear Hair = 5

Compatible with RPG Maker MZ！


Terms of Use:

* This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
* OK to be used in Commercial projects
* Contents can be edited
* OK for use in games with gore
* OK for use in adult-rated games
